title: Canada Goose Reports Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results
summary: Third quarter revenue grew 14% year-over-year led by strong performance in US and Mainland China 4 consecutive quarters of positive DTC comparable sales growth1 Canada Goose Holdings Inc. (NYSE, TSX: GOOS) announced today financial results for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 ended December 28, 2025. All amounts are in Canadian dollars unless otherwise indicated. “Our third‑quarter results underscore the strength of our global brand and top‑line engine, with broad‑based revenue growth and continued momentum across key regions and channels,” said Dani Reiss, Chairman and CEO of Canada Goose. “Our peak selling period reflected sharper execution — higher quality traffic driven by integrated global campaigns, strong consumer response to our expanded year‑round assortment, and robust performance across both retail and e-commerce.” “Margins this quarter reflected deliberate choices we made to expand product relevance and fuel brand momentum.
